 Advertisement Tracking early voting data in Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana
 Advertisement Updated: 10:41 AM EDT Oct 22, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Emily Sanderson Digital Media Manager Tracking early voting data in Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana
 Updated: 10:41 AM EDT Oct 22, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Emily Sanderson Digital Media Manager 
 Early voting is underway for the 2026 midterm elections in several states.
 Advertisement 
 Ohio, Kentucky, Indiana general election guide: What's on the ballot, polling info, more The Get the Facts Data Team is tracking early and mail-in ballots ahead of Election Day, Nov. 3. The data comes from the University of Florida Election Lab .
 Use the map above to see how many early votes have been cast in each state, including mail-in ballots accepted and early votes.
 Early voting turnout doubles in Greater Cincinnati compared to last midterm In 31 states plus Washington, D.C., voters can register under a party affiliation. When that data is available, it is included under a state's data. Not all states allow or have opened early voting yet.
 Early in-person voting turnout rises sharply in southwest Ohio In Hamilton County, 9,482 votes were cast during the first four days of early in-person voting, more than two and a half times the 3,616 votes cast during the same period in 2022.
 During the first eight days of early in-person voting, more than 11,000 Butler County residents cast their ballots—more than double the turnout during the same period in 2022.
 You can view WLWT's 2026 general election guide, highlighting key races in Ohio, Kentucky and Indiana by clicking here .
